description: Named content or records, or everything recorded under one scope, must be kept until this is released or its time has passed. A hold by scope covers what is recorded under that scope afterwards as well.

details.description: Issuer-defined detail: up to 64 named scalars. Nothing in it is interpreted by the base kinds, and nothing in it is content; content goes behind a reference.

scope.description: A content scope: a session, or a stream written as stream: followed by its name.

items.description: An exact reference to content, a record or a Core event.

until.description: RFC 3339 calendar-valid instant with up to nanosecond precision; leap seconds and unknown -00:00 offsets are outside this profile. ordered compares UTC instants, not text.
